_meta.purpose: Crisis-resource corpus for locale 'zh'. Loaded by ciris_engine.schemas.resources.crisis.load_crisis_registry and injected into DSDMA prompts via format_crisis_resources_block (CIRISAgent#971).
_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. Emergency (police/ambulance/fire) numbers for CN, SG added 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248): 5 of 5 meet the owner's cited-sources standard (source=multi_source_cited, emitted); the rest are staged verified=false and NOT emitted — see CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md.
